notes.title: Hotfix - v1.0.2
notes.notes: Just pushed a hotfix for objectives that were broken with the release of the tutorial.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Rockhoppers first update includes a handful of bug fixes and one big content update for new players.

Updates include:


 Added new tutorial level - optional for existing players but helps ease the learning curve for new players.
 Removed tool tip on boost UI item
 Added some jump / landing checks to help prevent users getting to a state where they can't jump
 Several other minor bug fixes
